author: Insta360
description:
Got yourself some Insta360 gear, and looking to throw together some mega-viral shorts? Good news, we've got you covered.

Join Amir as he walks you through some of his favorite shots and how to achieve them, using some of our top-performing gear, including Insta360 X5, Flow 2 Pro, and our Bullet Time Cord.

Every example functions as a hands-on filmmaking tutorial, illustrating how simple filming decisions directly impact how viral-ready your reels feel in the edit. If you’re learning how to edit viral reels that hold attention and feel intentional, these ideas will help you build a stronger creative workflow.

Huge thanks to Amir for helping us out with this awesome compilation! Check him out here: @amirazakeri
